about: Hand-written metadata for the archive section. Everything else (titles, words, sources, lost list) is parsed from archive/src/INDEX.md and the markdown files themselves by scripts/build-archive.mjs. Currency marks: verified | timeless | outdated | dead | lost | pending | mixed.

angular-size-reddit-post.note: Dead as a method, priceless as a record. The archive's INDEX recorded this post as pending (automated fetch of reddit.com is blocked); it was saved by hand as a browser snapshot later the same day, 2026-11-09, post and 23 comments.

construction-system-guide.note: Construction has changed heavily since 2018: the modules are gone (replaced), the core is gone. Exception — the preview-placement trick (Ctrl+F11 + E) still works in 2026.

halospud-part2-shooting-mechanics-1v1-ba.note: Principles, qualitative. No numeric ADAD cadence anywhere in it — read as principles, not timings.

halospud-part4-movement-tricks.note: Principles, qualitative. Sprint strafing, the Therum Shuffle, sprint peeking, and repeeking are the movement layer of the ADAD question.

highly-technical-how-to-analyze-a-weapon.note: The Effective Range section is dead (it depended on the angular-size research). Everything else in it is mechanics, not numbers.

mirror__iridar__construction-system-guid.note: Construction has changed heavily since 2018: the modules are gone (replaced), the core is gone. Exception — the preview-placement trick (Ctrl+F11 + E) still works in 2026.

planetside2__weapons__weapon-mechanics.note: The CoF, recoil, bloom, and recovery mechanics are game constants. Weapon-stat examples are from 2016. The effective-range material built on angular size is dead.

toolbox.author: Iridar
toolbox.note: 10 sheets (Stats, Damage, Resistances, Built In Resistances, Cone of Fire, Recoil, Attachments, Categories, Implants, Temp). Per-weapon damage, CoF per stance, bloom, recoil statistics, Monte Carlo horizontal deviation. 194 weapons. Data is 2018 (old Nanoweave, pre-rebalance); the method is timeless. The CoF page's effective-range function was already stripped in v4f after angular size died.
toolbox.title: Iridar's Weapon Analysis Toolbox (spreadsheet, v6h)

videos.author: Iridar
videos.note: No video file is stored. Title and channel confirmed via YouTube oEmbed 2026-11-09; transcript unavailable (YouTube rate-limited the fetch, HTTP 429). The CoF analysis in the video is dead by the author's own warning (based on the incorrect angular-size research); the rest is a 2017-era feature walkthrough of the tool.
videos.summary: A walkthrough of the Toolbox: loading a weapon, the analysis pages. Gauss SAW vs Nanoweave TTK; HVA effects on damage ranges and kill thresholds (Pulsar C as the case where HVA matters more); the Recoil page and horizontal deviation (Pulsar C's exceptionally low deviation vs the Cyclone); CoF-based effective ranges; Cyclone vs Armistice, including the Cyclone 3-headshot kill. The video's stated purpose is not balance argument — it is a practical tour of the tool's features.
videos.title: Weapon Analysis Toolbox Spotlight

videos.author: Iridar
videos.note: No video file is stored. Title and channel confirmed via YouTube oEmbed 2026-11-09; no transcript exists (the video has no speech). The trick it demonstrates — Ctrl+F11 to hide the weapon + E to place without starting construction — was verified still working in the live game in 2026.
videos.summary: A silent, 54-second gameplay demonstration of the Construction System's preview-placement mechanic: a player at the Crater Firing Range positions the translucent ghost of a construction piece before placing it. The visual companion to the Construction System Guide's Previewing Placement section.
videos.title: [MECHANIC] Preview placement before construction
